This collection blends deep, atmospheric synth-wave with the rhythmic patter of rain and cinematic electronic textures. Designed for late-night deep work, the soundscape mirrors the aesthetic of a rain-slicked metropolis under glowing neon lights.

Focus: Low-frequency synth pads and steady, hypnotic beats minimize distraction. Atmosphere: Natural rain recordings are layered behind tracks 02 and 06 for a grounded, immersive environment. Cinematic: High-contrast production values evoke the feeling of a late-night drive through a rainy cityscape.

The EACCES error occurs when the npm process lacks the necessary write permissions for system-level directories. Modifying system folder ownership is discouraged; instead, use a Node version manager to handle packages within your user home directory.
NVM (Node Version Manager) | Install Node/npm in ~/.nvm | Safest; keeps files in user space
npm Prefix Config | Change global path to ~/.npm-global | Isolates npm from system paths
Chown (Not Recommended) | Change /usr/local/lib/node_modules | Risks system stability/security
NVM allows you to manage multiple versions of Node.js and installs packages in a directory you own by default.
If you must use the system-installed Node, tell npm to use a directory in your home folder.

mkdir "/.npm-global"
npm config set prefix "/.npm-global"
export PATH=$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH
source ~/.bashrc
Check current owner | ls -ld $(npm config get prefix)/lib/node_modules | Verify if owned by root
Verify path | echo $PATH | Local bin listed before system
Avoid sudo | Never use sudo npm install -g | Prevent security risk

mkdir "/.npm-global"
npm config set prefix "/.npm-global"
export PATH=$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH
source ~/.bashrc

Product Launch Roadmap: From Concept to Market
1. Validation | Product-Market Fit | User interviews; prototype testing; feedback loops | Refined MVP spec
2. Foundation | Brand Identity | Logo design; tone-of-voice; legal/domain setup | Brand guidelines
3. Infrastructure | Store Build | Platform selection; product photography; checkout config | Live staging site
4. Pre-Launch | Market Awareness | Teaser campaigns; email list building; influencer outreach | Waitlist/Campaign
5. Go-to-Market | Official Launch | Ad spend activation; PR outreach; customer support | Sales-ready store
Iterative Testing: Prioritize gathering qualitative feedback during Phase 1 to prevent costly pivots later in the development cycle.
Brand Consistency: Ensure your visual identity and messaging are finalized before the storefront build to streamline design implementation.
Launch Velocity: Focus the pre-launch phase on capturing high-intent leads so that your Day 1 traffic is primed to convert.
